info.syllabusName: Leading Sustainable Community Transformation_Phát triển cộng đồng bền vững
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 50h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 96 self-study
info.description: This course aims to lay the groundwork for addressing complex problems, engaging stakeholders, and offering tools for collecting and analyzing data to tackle community transformation challenges in a comprehensive way. Learners will have the chance to draft a proposal based on systems thinking principles, describe and visualize the system and its components relevant to a specific project focus, apply systems thinking and project management concepts, and collaborate with stakeholders to assess and identify community needs.
info.studentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

4. Keep up with online learning progress (bonus will be awarded)

5. Communicate and discuss in forum

6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional)

7. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
info.note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

clos.loDetails: Apply systems thinking to identify and analyze complex community challenges, integrating sustainability into project planning.
Master data collection and analysis techniques, to inform evidence-based decision-making for community transformation initiatives.
Develop comprehensive project proposals using systems mapping and stakeholder analysis to address identified needs effectively.
Evaluate community transformation strategies through the lens of sustainability leadership, considering economic, social, and environmental impacts to drive long-term value creation.
Collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams to achieve shared transformation goals.
